faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Pune (IISER Pune) for its upcoming research project under the National Quantum Mission.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in IISER Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: IISER Pune is hiring candidates for Research Associate-I, Research Associate-II, and Research Associate-III positions under advertisement number 79/2026 on a temporary and contractual basis.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in total?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available across the Research Associate-I, Research Associate-II, and Research Associate-III positions, with 1 vacancy allocated for each post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Research Associate posts?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Ph.D. degree in Physics or a closely relevant discipline. Candidates who have recently submitted their thesis are also eligible to apply for certain positions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The upper age limit varies by post: 35 years for Research Associate-I, 36 years for Research Associate-II, and 37 years for Research Associate-III as specified in the recruitment advertisement.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these Research Associate roles?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 58,000/- to Rs. 67,000/- depending on the post level, along with an additional 30% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply for IISER Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 15 October 2026. Candidates must ensure their emails reach the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via email. Interested candidates must convert their application into a PDF format and send it to the official email address provided by IISER Pune.

faq.question: Q9. Do I need to pay any application fee?
faq.answer: No application fee has been prescribed or mentioned in the official notification released by IISER Pune for these contractual research positions.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for these roles?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial screening of all received applications followed by an interview process conducted exclusively for the shortlisted candidates.
